paragraphs: [Avodah Zarah 30a](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.30a.4) relates that Rabbi Yannai, son of Rabbi Yishmael, fell ill. Rabbi Yishmael ben Zirud and the other rabbis went in to inquire after him. As they sat, a question arose; Rabbi Yishmael ben Zirud told them, “Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish said this in the name of Rabbi Chiya.”[^1]

notes.text: The linked Bavli has Rabbi Yishmael ben Zirud visit the ill Rabbi Yannai and convey the teaching of Resh Lakish in Rabbi Chiyya’s name. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2271&lang=en) gives both the visit and the chain.
